name: Elite Soldier
description: An armored squire or experienced commoner looking to advance.

abilities.name: Reinforce
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to move into Melee range of an ally and make a standard attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d10+2 physical damage and the ally can clear a Stress.

abilities.name: Vassal’s Loyalty
abilities.description: When the Soldier is within Very Close range of a knight or other noble who would take damage, you can mark a Stress to move into Melee range of them and take the damage instead.
